messages:
Maya Rivera: Quick sync: prepping cost-focused QBR pack for NovaPulse next Tue. Finance noticed an unexpected spike in token consumption tied to nightly analytics. Need runway, forecast, and an automated alert playbook.

Samir Gupta: Can we get a POI on which routes spiked? embeddings vs generation?

Lina Park: Early look: total 9.2M tokens last 30d. embeddings 5.6M (61%), generation 3.6M (39%). Most embeddings from /vectorize-batch endpoint.

Noah Brooks: Logs show a cron job running an all-table re-embed at 03:15 UTC twice a week. Payloads are large (avg 1.2k tokens per document).

Samir Gupta: Recommend three mitigations: 1) switch to incremental re-embed (delta-only), 2) add per-request size cap, 3) enable K/V prefix caching. Could save ~30% on embedding tokens.

Maya Rivera: Good. I need a short one-pager + a deck slide for the QBR outlining those recommendations and the forecast delta. Also want budget alerts at 70% and 85% of their committed run rate.

Sophia Martinez: I'll draft the slide. Can someone generate a 30d cost forecast baseline + post-mitigation scenario?

Samir Gupta: Quick projection: baseline 30d spend ~ $4.5k. With 30% embedding reduction -> ~ $3.2k. I'll export CSV.

Noah Brooks: BudgetBot, create alerts and run a simulated spike to confirm routing.

BudgetBot: Alerts created for novapulse: thresholds 70%, 85%. Use /simulate-burn to trigger tests. :robot_face:

Noah Brooks: Triggered simulator (+150k embedding tokens). 70% alert fired to #nova-ops and to finance@novapulse.com. 85% not fired. Screenshot uploaded to QBR assets.

Maya Rivera: Action items: Samir -> mitigation notes + example config (EOD). Lina -> attach route spend and payload-size histogram. Sophia -> slide + one-pager. Noah -> screenshots + ensure alert emails are going to correct contacts. I'll run the QBR walkthrough.

Samir Gupta: Example config snippet: ```yaml
reembed:
  mode: incremental
  window: 1h
  batch_size: 250
  max_doc_tokens: 800
cache:
  enable_prefix_kv: true
```

Lina Park: Uploaded route spend CSV and histograms to QBR folder.

Maya Rivera: Also capture customer feedback: did they notice drop in retrieval quality after switching to low-precision embeddings? Add a poll to the QBR invite.

Sophia Martinez: Added poll: "Have you observed reduced retrieval accuracy since quantization?" and a checkbox on the agenda to collect notes.

Maya Rivera: Thanks team. I'll circulate the assembled packet Mon AM and confirm the enablement walkthrough time. :white_check_mark:
